subject: SIG request: developer process artifacts and change-control logs
messages:
From: Arianne Soto <arianne@whitehat-assessors.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: developer process artifacts request

Hi Ben / team,

Following our kickoff call for the SIG assessment of LumaPay, we need a compact bundle of artifacts to validate your secure development controls. Please provide the items below by COB Friday (23 Jun) if possible. If any of these require redaction or an alternate delivery mechanism, flag it in your reply.

Required artifacts (high priority):
- Code review policy (proc and checklist) and a CSV summarizing PR outcomes for the last 12 months
- CI/CD pipeline config and a sample build log demonstrating gated deploys
- Proof of secrets management: a short log or screenshot showing rotation events and access policies
- Change management evidence: runbook describing approvals, and 3 sample change tickets (with approval trail)
- A brief note on how you roll out emergency changes and rollback procedures

Attachments are OK as stubs — we just need verifiable filenames and pointers, then we can request secure transfer for any sensitive artifacts.

Thanks,
Arianne Soto
Senior Assessor
WhiteHat Assessors

[Attachment: sig_mapping_followup.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Arianne Soto <arianne@whitehat-assessors.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: developer process artifacts request

Arianne — thanks, received. We're assembling a focused bundle and can provide the following by EOD Thu (23 Jun):

- code_review_summary.csv (PR count, approvals, reviewer roles; 12-month slice) [Attachment]
- ci_pipeline_export.json (pipeline YAML + sample successful build log) [Attachment: ci_pipeline_export.json]
- change_control_runbook.pdf (procedures + sample approval flow) [Attachment]
- kms_rotation_audit.log (sanitized rotation events for last 6 months) [Attachment]

Quick notes:
- Secrets are stored in our vault (AWS Secrets Manager for hosted, HashiCorp Vault for private deployments). We rotate service-level keys quarterly and KMS keys annually — will include log snippets.
- Emergency changes are escalated via the on-call channel, require 2 approvals from infra lead + security, and trigger an automated rollback job if smoke tests fail.

If you need full ticket exports rather than PDFs, tell us which system (Jira or Zendesk) and we can request a secure transfer.

Ben Carter
Senior Security PM
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: code_review_summary.csv, ci_pipeline_export.json, change_control_runbook.pdf, kms_rotation_audit.log]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Arianne Soto <arianne@whitehat-assessors.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: developer process artifacts request

Adding context on delivery and scope for the artifacts Ben listed.

- code_review_summary.csv: generated from our internal analytics export; includes PR id, author, reviewers, approval timestamps, and merge gate status. We removed code diffs for external review.
- ci_pipeline_export.json: pipeline generator output (we use a templated pipeline in the repo); sample build log included showing gated integration tests and canary promotion steps.
- change_control_runbook.pdf: updated March 2027 to include the new Change Advisory Board (CAB) step; sample change ticket IDs: RDW-4278, RDW-4982, RDW-5033.

Link to secure folder for secure transfer (internal): https://drive.redwoodcompany.internal/shared/secure-sdlc/LumaPay-artifacts

One action item for Soojin: can you confirm the exact KMS key alias and a one-line explanation of our annual rotation process?

Thanks — Monica

[Inline: sample ticket headers and truncated approval chains included in the runbook PDF]

From: Arianne Soto <arianne@whitehat-assessors.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, SIG Portal <sig-portal@auditcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: developer process artifacts request

Ben / Monica — appreciate the fast turnaround and the artifact stubs. Couple of quick follow-ups before we mark items as received:

- For the KMS rotation entries in kms_rotation_audit.log: can you provide one sample event showing the rotation-triggering principal and the approval ticket id? A sanitized line is fine (mask any account ids).
- For the CI pipeline sample log, we need the step that demonstrates blocked deploy when integration tests fail. Please quote the failing step and the pipeline status line.

If you prefer, upload the two small items to the secure folder and post the upload ID here; otherwise we can accept them via the SIG Portal link.

Once we have those two snippets, we'll map them to the SIG control matrix and send a short gap list (if any).

Thanks — looking good so far.

Arianne Soto
Senior Assessor
WhiteHat Assessors

[Attachment: sig_mapping_followup.xlsx]
